title: Square summability of Hermite coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be square-integrable with respect to the $n$-dimensional standard Gaussian measure. Then the squared Hermite coefficients of $f$ are summable over all multi-indices $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$; that is, $\sum_{\alpha\in\mathbb N^n}(\widehat f(\alpha))^2<\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is in $L^2$ for the product standard Gaussian measure
